name: ShiftHaul Car Shipping Calculator
author: shifthaul

sections.description:
Selling cars to buyers in other states? Add a car shipping calculator to your website in one minute.

The buyer types where the car is going, sees the route drawn on a map of the United States, picks the vehicle and gets a door-to-door shipping price from ShiftHaul, a licensed auto transport broker (FMCSA MC 1786043, USDOT 4511175). The price is shown after the buyer enters a name, email and phone.

Why dealers use it

  • Your lot ZIP is filled in. The buyer only types where the car goes.
  • Your name at the top — “Partner of your business“.
  • Orders from your calculator are credited to you. Join the free ShiftHaul partner program and enter your partner code in the settings.
  • The whole vehicle list — makes and models from 1930 to today, open or enclosed trailer, running or not.
  • Looks the same everywhere. A compact card up to 480 px wide (or full width), sets its own height, works on phones.
  • Nothing to maintain. No API keys, no styles to fight with your theme.

How to use

  1. Settings → ShiftHaul Calculator: enter your partner code, and optionally your lot ZIP and business name.
  2. Add the block “ShiftHaul Car Shipping Calculator” to any page, or paste the shortcode [shifthaul_calculator].

Shortcode attributes (all optional, they replace the settings for that one place): partner, zip, name, size (compact or wide).
Example: [shifthaul_calculator zip="46802" size="wide"]

External services

This plugin shows the ShiftHaul quote calculator, which runs on shifthaul.com. It is required for the plugin to work.

  • What it is: ShiftHaul (DBW Transport LLC d/b/a ShiftHaul), a licensed auto transport broker. The calculator is loaded in a frame from https://shifthaul.com/embed/quote/.
  • What is sent and when: when a page with the calculator opens, the visitor’s browser loads the frame from shifthaul.com. The frame address contains the partner code, lot ZIP and business name from the plugin settings (if set). When a visitor uses the calculator, the details they type into it (pickup and delivery ZIP codes, vehicle, and later name, email and phone) go directly to ShiftHaul to prepare a car shipping quote. Your website does not receive or store this data, and the plugin does not read your page or set cookies.
  • ShiftHaul terms: https://shifthaul.com/terms/
  • ShiftHaul privacy policy: https://shifthaul.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress: Plugins → Add New → search for “ShiftHaul”, install and activate. Or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it.
  2. Settings → ShiftHaul Calculator: enter your partner code (from your ShiftHaul partner kit).
  3. Add the block “ShiftHaul Car Shipping Calculator” or the shortcode [shifthaul_calculator] to a page.
sections.faq:
Where do I get a partner code?

Apply for the free ShiftHaul partner program at https://shifthaul.com/partner-program/. Once approved, your partner kit has your code.

Does it work without a partner code?

Yes. The calculator works the same, but orders are not credited to you.

Who handles the shipment?

ShiftHaul. The buyer books with ShiftHaul, and ShiftHaul arranges a licensed, insured carrier and handles the order from pickup to delivery.

Can the buyer change the pickup ZIP?

Yes. Your lot ZIP is only filled in to save the buyer time.

Does the plugin slow down my site?

No. The calculator frame loads lazily, and the plugin adds one small script (under 2 KB) that sets the frame height.

Can I use it in a widget area or with a page builder?

Yes. Use the shortcode [shifthaul_calculator] in a Shortcode block, a text widget or your page builder’s shortcode element.
